text.p: Two brokerage houses cut their recommendations on retailer Castorama's stock after an analysts' meeting with the company on Thursday, portfolio managers said.
Dupont-Denant lowered its rating on the stock to underperform from outperform, and SGE Delahaye revised its rating to neutral from outperform.
Cheuvreux de Virieu kept the share on its favoured list but lowered its EPS estimate to 48.20 francs for 1997 from 50.30.
Analysts said they left the meeting with the impression that the group was not expanding abroad fast enough to compensate for a difficult retail climate and tough sector rules in France.
The stock was down 23 francs at 876 at 1440 GMT.
